## Rationale

These 5 issues address practical gaps identified through codebase analysis:

1. **TUI copy-paste** - Users need to copy error messages and URLs from TUI. Terminal selection works but clipboard integration is missing.

2. **Model aliases** - Long model IDs (`sap-ai-core/anthropic--claude-4.7-opus`) are verbose. Aliases (`opus`, `sonnet`) improve CLI ergonomics.

3. **Agent turn timeout** - Runaway agent loops can consume quota without progress. Configurable per-turn timeout (default 5 min) catches infinite loops early.

4. **Session export** - Users want to archive sessions or share debugging transcripts. Currently sessions persist only as binary JSON in `~/.alexi/sessions/`.

5. **Provider health check** - Users discover credential/network issues mid-session after wasting quota. Proactive validation (`alexi provider health`) verifies setup before sessions start.

All issues are self-contained, implementable by engineering agents without questions, and include specific file paths, acceptance criteria, and test requirements.
